answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a test cabinet with secondary contacts and control relays, which aligns with the features of the CROWN-ARMV product, as it is designed for metal-clad switchgear applications.
The requirement for special wrenches and manual devices corresponds to accessories for switchgear, which are provided by the CROWN-ACC product.
The spare parts and touch-up paint are typical accessories for switchgear maintenance, which are covered by the CROWN-ACC product.
Test plugs are accessories for switchgear testing, which are included in the CROWN-ACC product catalog.
The requirement for protective finishes and coatings is part of the construction and finish of metal-clad switchgear, which is provided by the CROWN-ARMV product.
Nameplates are part of the front panel and internal device specifications for metal-clad switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product.
Workmanship is a general requirement and does not specify a product. It is addressed by the bid manager.
Compliance with contract documents is a commercial requirement and does not specify a product. It is addressed by the bid manager.
